---
title: "Explore genomes"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

This is an early (phase B) interactive view. Each point is one genome. Nothing here is controlled for phylogeny, so related genomes are not independent and the correlations below are descriptive only. The default shows all genomes. Use the toggle to restrict to representative genomes (one per species). The static pages use representatives only, so counts differ.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
raw = {
  try {
    return await FileAttachment("data/genomes.json").json();
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
loadError = raw === null
  ? html`<div style="border:2px solid #b00020;padding:0.75em;border-radius:4px">The data file <code>data/genomes.json</code> could not be loaded, so the explorer is not available. Reload the page or use the static pages from the navigation bar.</div>`
  : html``
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
genomes = raw === null ? [] : raw.rows.map(r => Object.fromEntries(raw.fields.map((f, i) => [f, r[i]])))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
numFields = raw === null ? [] : Object.keys(raw.columns)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
label = f => `${raw.columns[f].label} (${raw.columns[f].unit})`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
phylaAll = ["All"].concat(Array.from(new Set(genomes.map(d => d.phylum))).sort())
```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
logDefault = new Set(["genome_mb", "n50_bp", "median_intron_len_bp", "median_intergenic_bp", "n_genes"])
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof xvar = Inputs.select(numFields, {label: "x axis", value: "genome_mb", format: label})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof yvar = Inputs.select(numFields, {label: "y axis", value: "busco_complete", format: label})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof level = Inputs.select(raw === null ? [] : raw.levels, {label: "Colour by", value: "phylum"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof phylum = Inputs.select(phylaAll, {label: "Phylum filter", value: "All"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof repsOnly = Inputs.radio(["All genomes", "Representatives only"], {label: "Genomes", value: "All genomes"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof logx = Inputs.toggle({label: "Log x", value: logDefault.has(xvar)})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof logy = Inputs.toggle({label: "Log y", value: logDefault.has(yvar)})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
pts = genomes.filter(d =>
  d[xvar] != null && d[yvar] != null &&
  (phylum === "All" || d.phylum === phylum) &&
  (repsOnly === "All genomes" || d.is_representative === true) &&
  (!logx || d[xvar] > 0) && (!logy || d[yvar] > 0))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
function pearson(a, b) {
  const n = a.length;
  if (n < 3) return NaN;
  const ma = d3.mean(a), mb = d3.mean(b);
  let sab = 0, saa = 0, sbb = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const da = a[i] - ma, db = b[i] - mb;
    sab += da * db; saa += da * da; sbb += db * db;
  }
  return sab / Math.sqrt(saa * sbb);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
function ranks(v) {
  const idx = d3.range(v.length).sort((i, j) => v[i] - v[j]);
  const r = new Array(v.length);
  let i = 0;
  while (i < idx.length) {
    let j = i;
    while (j + 1 < idx.length && v[idx[j + 1]] === v[idx[i]]) j++;
    const avg = (i + j) / 2 + 1;
    for (let k = i; k <= j; k++) r[idx[k]] = avg;
    i = j + 1;
  }
  return r;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
fmt = x => Number.isFinite(x) ? x.toFixed(3) : "not defined"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
stats = {
  const a = pts.map(d => d[xvar]), b = pts.map(d => d[yvar]);
  const la = logx ? a.map(Math.log10) : a, lb = logy ? b.map(Math.log10) : b;
  return {n: pts.length, pearson: pearson(la, lb), spearman: pearson(ranks(a), ranks(b))};
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p><strong>${stats.n.toLocaleString()}</strong> genomes shown. Pearson r${(logx || logy) ? " (log10)" : ""} = <strong>${fmt(stats.pearson)}</strong>. Spearman r = <strong>${fmt(stats.spearman)}</strong>. Both use the displayed points and ignore phylogeny.${(logx || logy) ? " Pearson r is computed on log10 of each logged axis, as in the static figures. Spearman r is rank-based and does not depend on the log scale." : ""}</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
colorMap = raw === null ? {} : raw.colors[level]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
groupsShown = {
  const n = d3.rollup(pts, v => v.length, d => d[level]);
  return Array.from(n.keys()).sort((a, b) => n.get(b) - n.get(a));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
legendGroups = groupsShown.slice(0, 20)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
 const desc = `Scatter plot of ${label(xvar)} against ${label(yvar)}, coloured by ${level}, ${pts.length.toLocaleString()} genomes`;
 const fig = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 900),
  height: Math.min(520, Math.max(300, width * 0.7)),
  marginLeft: 55,
  caption: desc,
  x: {type: logx ? "log" : "linear", label: label(xvar), grid: true},
  y: {type: logy ? "log" : "linear", label: label(yvar), grid: true},
  color: {domain: groupsShown, range: groupsShown.map(g => colorMap[g] || "#9a9a9a")},
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(pts, {x: xvar, y: yvar, fill: level, r: 2.5, fillOpacity: 0.55,
      title: d => `${d.id}\n${d.phylum} / ${d.class}\n${d.genus}`, tip: true})
  ]
})
 const svg = fig.tagName.toLowerCase() === "svg" ? fig : fig.querySelector("svg");
 svg.setAttribute("aria-label", desc);
 svg.setAttribute("role", "img");
 return fig;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.4em 1em;font-size:0.85em">${legendGroups.map(g => html`<span style="white-space:nowrap"><span style="display:inline-block;width:0.9em;height:0.9em;background:${colorMap[g] || "#9a9a9a"};margin-right:0.3em;vertical-align:middle"></span>${g}</span>`)}${legendGroups.includes("Other (small groups)") ? html`<span>grey = pooled small groups</span>` : ""}${groupsShown.length > legendGroups.length ? html`<span>and ${groupsShown.length - legendGroups.length} more groups (not listed)</span>` : ""}</div>`
```

Top 10 displayed genomes by the y variable:

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(pts.slice().sort((a, b) => b[yvar] - a[yvar]).slice(0, 10), {
  columns: ["id", "phylum", "class", xvar, yvar],
  header: {[xvar]: raw && raw.columns[xvar].label, [yvar]: raw && raw.columns[yvar].label},
  layout: "auto"
})
```

Missing values (null in the data) are left out of a plot, so the count changes with the axes. BUSCO values come from the assembly, not from the prediction.
